_comment: Demo fixtures. `cut` MUST be the highest-scored entry in `feed` — that is the director rule, and scripts/verify.mjs asserts it against convex/rank.js. `headline` stands in for the Firecrawl news search; the URLs are example.org on purpose, so nothing here looks like a real citation.

cut.caption: The sky just turned green over the fjord — nobody down there is talking.
cut.headline: Tromsø braces for first real aurora season crowds as hotels report full October
